name: sicarius-guard
description: Solana Token Safety Oracle — 7-layer rug pull, honeypot, and market risk analysis for AI agents and trading bots.

tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description: Analyze a Solana SPL token for rug pull, honeypot, and safety risks. Performs 5 checks: mint authority, freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, honeypot simulation, and holder concentration.

tools.name: check_honeypot
tools.description: Check if a Solana token is a honeypot by simulating a sell order through Jupiter. Zero cost — only requests a quote.

tools.name: check_holder_concentration
tools.description: Analyze token holder distribution. Detects if supply is concentrated in a few wallets (rug pull indicator).

tools.name: full_token_scan
tools.description: Most comprehensive 7-layer safety analysis: on-chain byte-level inspection + Birdeye market intelligence + wallet reputation. Use for high-value trades.

tools.name: get_wallet_reputation
tools.description: Investigate a Solana wallet's reputation using Helius DAS identity data and funding chain analysis.

tools.name: get_market_intel
tools.description: Get real-time market intelligence from Birdeye: price, 24h volume, liquidity, market cap, holder count, and risk flags.

tools.name: batch_scan
tools.description: Scan up to 10 Solana tokens in parallel for portfolio-level risk assessment. Returns verdicts for each token.

mints.description: Array of Solana token mint addresses (max 10)
